messages.subject: [Fedora-r-devel-list] Rebuild packages for F26
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
	reading http://dl.fedoraproject.org/pub/alt/mass-rebuild/f26-failures.html 
we can see that all the R packages that depend on Fortran need to be rebuild 
for F-26, due to the mass rebuild (gcc upgrade).

	My question is what is the best way to proceed: should this be done in a 
centralized way or done individually by each packager?

Regards,
-- 
José Abílio
